# Introduction 

This document serves as the Verzeichnis der Lehrveranstaltungen, providing a structured overview of my teaching activities. It details the academic courses I have designed and delivered, my contributions to non-academic education, and my role in co-supervising graduate theses.

The Teaching Experience section presents formal university-level courses, emphasizing decision analysis, agroecology, and interdisciplinary research. These lectures and seminars have been integral to graduate and undergraduate programs, particularly at the University of Bonn and affiliated institutions.

The Teaching Outside Academia section highlights my engagement in experiential education beyond traditional academic settings. My involvement in maritime training, environmental education, and outdoor leadership has shaped my pedagogical approach by integrating hands-on learning with theoretical instruction.

The Co-Supervised Theses section documents my mentorship of graduate students conducting research on decision science and sustainable food systems. These projects reflect my commitment to interdisciplinary scholarship and applied problem-solving.

This Verzeichnis der Lehrveranstaltungen provides a comprehensive record of my teaching contributions, demonstrating my commitment to knowledge dissemination, student mentorship, and the integration of theory and practice.
